checks.explanation: No dedicated data on Manhattan second-home market impact from the pied-à-terre tax was found.
OpenAI's "Spud" model (which became GPT-5.5) was released, confirming the core prediction.
The predicted long-term ("fullness of time") valuation has not yet been reached or resolved.

Anthropic's annualized revenue was on a trajectory from about $47 billion (May 2026) to $65 billion (July 2026), on track toward but not yet confirmed at the predicted $80-100 billion year-end target.
Only New York enacted a full statewide data center ban; roughly ten states introduced moratorium bills or siting restrictions, far short of the predicted roughly 30 states banning them outright.
Anthropic confirmed a roughly $50 billion independent data-center buildout with ex-Google hires, matching the prediction that it would be forced to build its own capacity.
